                                   ALGEBRA                                    
==============================================================================

1.
   In the formula P=5/12K+30, if P is increased by 30, what is the increase in
   K?
   A) 72
   B) 90
   C) 36
   D) 65



2.
      10x+7y=27
      5x+14y=45
   The solution to the given system of equations is (x,y)=(p/60,z/124), where
   p and z are integers. What is the value of z-p?



3.
   In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered
   from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by x. The product
   of 12 and the second odd integer in the set is at most the value of 30 more
   than the sum of the third and fourth odd integers in the set. What is the
   greatest possible value of x?



4.
   The graph of the equation 3x-2y=6 is translated 4 units down and 2 units to
   the left.
   What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the resulting graph?



5.
   The graph of line g is shown in the xy-plane. Line s is defined by
   150x+ny=-m, where n and m are constants. If line s is graphed in this xy-
   plane, resulting in the graph of a system of two linear equations, the
   system of two linear equations will have infinitely many solutions. What is
   the value of n+m?
   [figure - see the PDF edition]



6.
   A bakery makes loaves of bread in three sizes: small, medium, and large. On
   a particular morning, the bakery makes twice as many small loaves as medium
   loaves, represented by m. They also bake 20 large loaves. If the bakery
   makes a total of 80 loaves that morning, which equation represents this
   situation?
   A) 2m+m+20=80
   B) 2(2m)+m+20=80
   C) 2m+20=80
   D) 3m+20=80



7.
   A baseball coach charges each athlete $150 for the first month and $95 for
   each additional month. Which of the following functions correctly
   represents the total revenue R(m), in dollars, for m months and n athletes,
   where m and n are positive integers?
   A) R(m)=95mn+55
   B) R(m)=95mn+150
   C) R(m)=95mn+55n
   D) R(m)=95mn+150n



8.
      f(x)=-7x+b
   For the given function f(x), which of the following gives the equation for
   the function f(x)+20, given that the point (-4,0) lies on the graph of
   f(x)-20?
   A) f(x)=-7x-28
   B) f(x)=-7x-8
   C) f(x)=-7x+8
   D) f(x)=-7x+12



9.
   One of the two equations in a system of linear equations is given. The
   system has no solution. Which equation could be the second equation in this
   system?
      7x=105y-133
   A) x=15y
   B) 1/7x=15y
   C) x=15y-19
   D) 1/7x=15y-19



10.
   What is the value of k/25 if the given equation only has one solution?
      25|x-4|=k
   A) -5 only
   B) 5 only
   C) 5 or -5
   D) 0



11.
   In the given system of equations, k is a constant. If the system has no
   solution, what is the value of k?
      3/8x+7/5y=9/7-7/5y
      5/4x+9/4=ky+4/3



12.
   One gallon of resin costs $79 and will cover 48 square feet of a
   countertop. The countertops in a given room have a total surface area of k
   square feet. Which equation represents the cost c, in dollars, of resin
   needed to cover the countertops twice?
   A) c=48k/79
   B) c=96k/79
   C) c=79(k/24)
   D) c=79(k/96)



13.
   For each real number r, which of the following points lies on the graph of
   each equation in the xy-plane for the given system?
      10x+8y=15
      25x+20y=37.5
   A) (r,\ -4r/5+15/8)
   B) (r,\ 5r/4+4/5)
   C) (-4r/5+3/2,\ r)
   D) (2r/5+10,\ -2r/5+25)



14.
   For the given system of equations, what is the value of 7(j-k)?
      (j-k)-16(m+l)=689
      (j-k)+12(m+l)=1235



15.
   A 34 pound dog eats two types of canned food: chicken and beef. The
   recommended amount of the chicken food is 1.25 cans per 16 pounds a dog
   weighs per day. The recommended amount of canned beef food is 0.85 cans per
   23 pounds a dog weighs per day. If c is the number of cans of chicken food
   and b is the number of cans of beef food a 34 pound dog eats in a given
   day. Which equation describes all possible values of c and b?
   A) 1.25/16c+0.85/23b=34
   B) 16/1.25c+23/0.85b=34
   C) 1.25/16b+0.85/23c=34
   D) 16/1.25b+23/0.85c=34



16.
   A small business owner budgets $3,600 to purchase timber each year. The
   owner must purchase a minimum of 345 slats of timber each year to maintain
   the discounted pricing. If the owner pays $7.25 to purchase each slat of
   pine pulpwood and $24.75 to purchase each slat of pine sawtimber, what is
   the maximum number of slats of pine sawtimber the owner can purchase to
   stay within the budget and maintain the discounted pricing?



17.
      -377x+k=377x+k
   If k is a constant, how many solutions does the given equation have?
   A) No solutions
   B) One solution
   C) Two solutions
   D) Infinite solutions



18.
   The graph of the linear equation passes through the points (-21,-89/2) and
   (12,65/2). The graph also passes through the point (27/4,a). What is the
   value of a?



19.
      7kx+13my=20.5
      6kx+5my=-48
   In the given system of equations, k and m are constants. The system has a
   solution of (2,y). What is the value of k?



20.
   Which of the following inequalities gives all possible values of k where
   the equation below has no solution?
      4-4|7/8+4/5x|=57/12+k
   A) k<-3/4
   B) k>-3/4
   C) k<=3/4
   D) k>=3/4



21.
   If 2a/b=4.25 and a/bn=8.5, what is the value of n?



22.
      7x-9y=39
      35x-45y=195
   For any real number r, which of the following points lies on the graph of
   both equations?
   A) (3r,(7r-13)/3)
   B) ((7r+13)/3,3r)
   C) (-7r/(-9)+39,7r/9+195)
   D) (r/5+39,-r/5+195)



23.
   The proposal for a development project was included on a city's election
   ballots. A local tv station reported that 6 times as many people voted in
   favor of the proposal as people who voted against it. If 1,770 more people
   voted in favor of the proposal than those who voted against the proposal.
   How many people voted against the proposal?



24.
   Which system of linear equations has no solution?
   A) -3x+7y=-9 and 3x-7y=9
   B) 3x-7y=5 and 2x+8y=6
   C) 4x-9y=7 and -12x+27y=-21
   D) -3x+8y=20 and 6x-16y=40



25.
   If (x-7)/5=(x-4)/3, the value x-4 is between which of the following pairs
   of values?
   A) -9 and -4
   B) -1 and 1
   C) 2 and 5
   D) 7 and 11



26.
   A handyman charges a flat rate of $218 for the first 3 hours of work and
   $68 for each additional hour of work. Which equation gives the total amount
   y, in dollars, that the handyman charges for x hours of work, where x>3?
   A) y=68x+218
   B) y=218x+68
   C) y=68x+14
   D) y=68x+422



27.
   Megan engages in up to 3 types of exercise each week for a total of 14
   hours while training for an ironman competition. Megan runs the same number
   of minutes each week. The equation y=780-x-200 represents the situation
   where Megan swims for x minutes during a week and bikes for any remaining
   training time y, in minutes. If this equation is graphed in the xy-plane,
   which of the following statements is true?
   A) During a week when Megan runs for 780 minutes, she bikes for 200
      minutes.
   B) Each week, Megan swims and bikes for a total of 780 minutes.
   C) During a week when Megan doesn't swim, she runs for 260 minutes.
   D) During a week when Megan doesn't bike, she swims for 390 minutes.



28.
      92x-1,789=kx-1,790
   In the given equation, k is a positive integer constant greater than 91.
   The equation has exactly one solution. What is the least possible value of
   k?



29.
   Lines c and d are perpendicular. If the equation of line c is y=mx+b and
   the lines intersect at point (7,6). Which point lies on line b?
   A) (7+m,\ 7)
   B) (2m,\ 8)
   C) (7+2m,\ 4)
   D) (7-3m,3)



30.
   What is the value of k if the given equation only has one solution?
      1/4|x-4|-30=2k



31.
   In the given pair of equations a and b are constants. The graph of this
   pair of equations in the xy-plane is a pair of perpendicular lines. Which
   of the following pairs of equations also represents a pair of perpendicular
   lines?
      13x+17y=10
      ax+by=10
   A) 39x+17y=10 and ax-3by=10
   B) 52x+34y=10 and 2ax+4by=10
   C) 65x+17y=10 and 5ax+by=10
   D) 13x-17y=10 and ax+by=10



32.
      77(x-k)=77y+77k
   One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given, where k
   is a positive constant. The system has no solution. Which equation could be
   the second equation in this system?
   A) 11x+11y=11k
   B) 11x+11y=22k
   C) 11x-11y=11k
   D) 11x-11y=22k



33.
   Line a is defined by 7x+8y=96. Line a is parallel to line b. An equation of
   line b is 42x=ky-96, where k is a constant. What is the y-intercept of line
   b?



34.
   A bakery makes 9-inch, 12-inch, and 14-inch pies. During a certain day, the
   number of 14-inch pies the bakery makes is 4 times the number n of 12-inch
   pies, and the number of 9-inch pies is 48. During this day, the bakery
   makes 190 pies in total. Which equation represents this situation?
   A) 9(48)+12n+14(4n)=190
   B) 9n+12n+14n=190
   C) 4n+48=190
   D) 5n+48=190



35.
   If x>=-13 represents all solutions to the inequality ax-75<=42, where a is
   a constant, what is the greatest possible value of a?



36.
      (14x+35)/4-b/12=a(x-7)
   In the given equation, a and b are constants. If the equation has
   infinitely many solutions, what is the value of b?



37.
      9x+5y=7
      45x+25y=35
   For each real number r, which of the following points lies on the graph of
   each equation in the xy-plane for the given system?
   A) (r/5+7,\ -r/5+35)
   B) (-5r/9+7/9,\ r)
   C) (r,\ 9r/5+7/5)
   D) (r,\ -5r/9+7/9)



38.
      1/7x+3k/13y=9/14
   One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given, where k
   is a nonzero constant. The system has no solution. If the other equation in
   the system is graphed in the xy-plane, what is the slope of the graph?
   A) 13k/21
   B) -13/21k
   C) 21k/13
   D) -21/13k



39.
   In a set of three consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered
   from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by k. The product
   of 17 and the second odd integer in the set is at most the value of 40 less
   than the sum of the first and third odd integers in the set. What is the
   greatest possible value of k?



40.
   For the linear function k, k(a)=-24, where a is a constant, k(4)=30, and
   the slope of the graph y=k(x) in the xy-plane is 7. For the linear function
   p, p(a)=26 and p(6)=38. What is the slope of the graph of y=p(x) in the xy-
   plane?



41.
   Line a in the xy-plane passes through the points (7/k,-3/k+9/15) and
   (5/k,-7/k+9/15), where k is a constant. Which of the following defines the
   y value of the y-intercept of line a?
   A) -38/k+3/5
   B) -32/k+3/5
   C) -17/k+3/5
   D) -70/k+3/5



42.
   The graph of the line a is shown in the xy-plane. Line b is defined by
   178x+ky=j, where k and j are constants. If line b is graphed in this xy-
   plane, resulting in a graph of a system of two linear equations, the system
   of two linear equations will have infinitely many solutions. What is the
   value of k+j?
   [figure - see the PDF edition]



43.
      3/5x+7/4y=a
      7/11x+by=c
   In the given system of equations, a, b, and c are constants. The system has
   infinitely many solutions. What is the value of a/c?

                                ADVANCED MATH

44.
   The function p is defined by p(x)=a((x+5)^2-b)((x+5)^2-c), where a, b, and
   c are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of y=p(x) passes through the
   points (-4,34) and (0,150). What is the value of p(-10)+p(-4)?



45.
   In the xy-plane, the graph of function f, where y=f(x), has exactly 8
   x-intercepts. One of these x-intercepts is (17,0). The rational function g
   is defined by g(x)=(f(x))/(x-17). In the xy-plane, how many x-intercepts
   does the graph of y=g(x) have?



46.
   The function f is defined by f(x)=(x-7)(x-4)(x+k), where k is a constant.
   In the xy-plane, the graph of y=f(x) passes through the point (-2,0). What
   is the value of f(0)?
   A) -2
   B) 56
   C) 7
   D) -17



47.
   x^2+7x+6 has two solutions r and s, r<s, and x^2+6x-7 has two solutions t
   and u, t<u. If x^2+cx+d has two solutions t+r and u+s, what is the value of
   c?



48.
      x(kx-20)=-1
   In the given equation, k is an integer constant. If the equation has two
   distinct real solutions, what is the greatest possible value of k?



49.
      f(x)=9^x+4
      g(x)=7x+b
   The given system of equations intersects at points (e,f) and (g,h), where
   h<f. What is the least possible value of b?
   A) 5
   B) 3
   C) 9
   D) 4



50.
   In the xy-plane, a parabola has vertex (-2,-1) and intersects the x-axis at
   two points. If the equation of the parabola is written in the form
   y=ax^2+bx+c, where a, b, and c are constants, which of the following could
   be the value of 2a+b+3c?
   A) -2
   B) -18
   C) -3
   D) -7



51.
   The function f is defined by f(x)=a^x+b, where a and b are constants. In
   the xy-plane, the graph of y=f(x) has an x-intercept at (2,0) and a
   y-intercept at (0,-195). What is the value of a+b?



52.
   The function f is defined by f(x)=ax^2+bx+c, where a, b, and c are
   constants and 1<a<4. The graph of y=f(x) in the xy-plane passes through the
   points (-10,0) and (-5,0). If a is an integer, what could be the value of
   a+b?



53.
      f(x)=5x^2+20x+148
   The function g is defined by g(x)=f(x+4). What is the minimum value of
   g(x)?



54.
   (x+4) is a factor of the quadratic function y=f(x), and x=c is a positive
   zero of the function. If the minimum of the function is (3/4,k), what is
   the value of c?



55.
      f(x)=-(x-a)(x-b)
   The function f is defined by the given equation, where a and b are integer
   constants. If f(-30)<0, f(-10)>0 and f(20)<0 and a<b, what is the minimum
   possible value of a-b?



56.
   The function k is defined by k(s)=sqrt(s+84). If k(5p)=p, where p is a
   constant, what is the value of p?



57.
   The expression 6x^2+bx-35, where b is a constant, can be rewritten as
   (hx+k)(x+j), where h, k, and j are integer constants. Which of the
   following must be an integer?
   A) b/h
   B) b/j
   C) 35/h
   D) 35/j



58.
   In the xy-plane, a line with the equation y=mx-30 does not intersect with a
   parabola with the equation y=2x^2-3x-m, where m is a constant. Which of the
   following is a possible value for m?
   A) only -7
   B) -7 and 7
   C) -27
   D) 25



59.
      (x+4)^2+(x^2+4x)=(x+4)(x-8)
   In the given equation, x!=-4. What is the solution to the given equation?



60.
   In the given equation, m is a positive constant. The product of the
   solutions to the equation is 28. What is the value of m?
      2/3(3x+7)(x+sqrt(2m+6))(x-sqrt(2m+6))=0



61.
   Function f is defined by f(x)=4x^2-12x+5 on the xy-plane, where f(x)=y.
   Function g intersects the x-axis twice when graphed on the xy-plane. Which
   of the following equations could define g(x), if k represents a positive
   constant?
   A) g(x)=f(x-k)
   B) g(x)=f(x+k)
   C) g(x)=f(x)+k
   D) g(x)=f(x)-k



62.
   The function f is defined by f(x)=x^2+bx+c, where b and c are constants. If
   the x-intercepts of the graph of f in the xy-plane are -2 and 5, what is
   the value of b?
   A) -3
   B) -2
   C) -5
   D) 2



63.
   The equation x^2+mx+5=0, where m is a positive integer, has no real
   solutions. What is the greatest possible value of m?



64.
   Given the function g(x)=33(k)^x, where k is a positive constant. For each
   increase of 1 in the value of x, the value of g(x) increases by p%, where
   0<p<200. Which expression represents p in terms of k?
   A) 100k
   B) 100(k-1)
   C) k+100
   D) 100(k+1)



65.
   For a quadratic function f(x)=x^2+bx+c, the value f(2)=-1 is the vertex of
   the function. What is the value of c?



66.
   The function p is defined by p(x)=c(2.5^x+2.5^d), where c and d are
   positive integer constants and c<d. The functions q and r are equivalent to
   function p, where s and t are constants. Which of the following equations
   displays the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of y=p(x) in the
   xy-plane as a constant or coefficient?
   I. q(x)=c(2.5^x+s)
   II. r(x)=c(2.5)^x+t
   A) I only
   B) II only
   C) I and II
   D) Neither I nor II



67.
   The function V models the value, in dollars, of a rare coin t years after
   1990:
      V(t)=500(1.06)^t/3
   According to the model, the value of the coin is predicted to increase by
   6% every n years. What is the value of n?
   A) 1
   B) 3
   C) 6
   D) 18



68.
   The function h is defined by h(x)=(x+1)(x-4)(x-7)^2. The value of h(5+m) is
   0, where m is a constant. What is the sum of all possible values of m?



69.
      3x^2+6ax+12=0
   The equation has no real solutions if a^2<j. What is the greatest possible
   integer value of j?



70.
      14x^2+(14m+3n)x+3mn=0
   In the function, m and n are positive constants. The product of the
   solutions to the given equation is pmn, where p is a constant. What is the
   value of p?



71.
   The function f(x) is defined by f(x)=m((x-3)^2-n)((x-3)^2-p), where m, n,
   and p are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of y=f(x) passes through
   the points (2,12) and (6,108). What is the value of f(1)+f(5)?



72.
   (x+7) is a factor of the quadratic function y=f(x), and x=c is a positive
   zero of the function. If the minimum of the function is (63/8,k), what is
   the value of c?



73.
      y=-3x^2-58
      y=px-46
   In the given system of equations, p is a constant. The graphs of the
   equations in the given system intersect at exactly one point, (x,y) in the
   xy-plane. Which of the following could be the value of x?
   A) -2
   B) -4
   C) 12
   D) 16



74.
      f(x)=a^x-b
   The exponential function given above passes through points (c,8) and
   (2c,350). What is a possible value of b?



75.
   For the function f, for every increase of 1/2 in the value of x, the value
   of f(x) increases by a factor of c, where c is a constant. Which of the
   following forms of function f displays the value of c as the base or
   coefficient?
   A) f(x)=56(2)^6x
   B) f(x)=56(8)^2x
   C) f(x)=56(64)^x
   D) f(x)=56(4,096)^x/2



76.
   The quadratic function ax^2+200x+c has at least one real solution. What is
   the greatest possible value of ac?



77.
   The area of a triangle is equal to x^2 square inches. The base of the
   triangle is 5+2x inches, and the height of the triangle is x-2 inches. What
   is the value of x?
   A) 2.5
   B) 2.7
   C) 5
   D) 10



78.
   The function f is defined by f(x)=a^x+b, where a and b are constants. In
   the xy-plane, the graph of y=f(x) has an x-intercept at (3,0) and a
   y-intercept at (0,-342). What is the value of a+b?



79.
   Two numbers a and b, are each greater than zero, and the fifth root of a is
   equal to the cube root of b. For what value of x is a^8x-4 equal to b?



80.
   A model initially estimates that there are 24,000 bacteria on a petri dish.
   14 days later, the model estimates that there are 96,000 bacteria on the
   petri dish. Assuming exponential growth, the formula B=a(2)^xd gives the
   estimated number of bacteria on a petri dish, where a and x are constants
   and B is the number of bacteria on the petri dish d days after the initial
   measurement. What is the value of x?
   A) 1/14
   B) 1/7
   C) 7
   D) 14



81.
   If a>0, x^2+y^2=a and xy=a-10, what is (x+y)^2 in terms of a?
   A) a-20
   B) 2a-10
   C) 2a-20
   D) 3a-20



82.
   f(x)=200(b)^x. When x increases by 1, f(x) increases by c%. Which of the
   following expresses c in terms of b?
   A) c=200b/100
   B) c=2b/100
   C) c=(b+1)100
   D) c=(b-1)100



83.
   A quadratic function models the height, in feet, of an object above the
   ground in terms of time, in seconds, after the object is launched. The
   model indicates the object launched from the ground (0 feet) and reaches
   its maximum height of 576 feet above the ground 12 seconds after being
   launched. Based on the model, what is the height, in feet, of the object
   above the ground 16 seconds after being launched?
   A) 384
   B) 432
   C) 480
   D) 512



84.
   A quadratic function models the height, in feet, of an object above the
   ground in terms of time, in seconds, after the object is launched off an
   elevated surface. The model indicates that at a time of 9 seconds, the
   object is 294 feet above the ground. At a time of 13 seconds, the object is
   310 feet above the ground. If the object was at a height of 24 feet when it
   was launched, what is the height, in feet, of the object above ground 18
   seconds after being launched?
   A) 96
   B) 192
   C) 222
   D) 240



85.
   n^5/3=k^2/5 and n^4a+1=k, what is the value of a?



86.
   3x^2+bx-112=(ax+m)(x-l). Given that a, m, and l are integers, which of the
   following must be true?
   A) m is a factor of b
   B) a is a factor or 112
   C) a if a factor of b
   D) l is a factor of 112



87.
   The vertex of the function f(x) is given as (9,-13), and the point (3,-4)
   lies on the parabola. If g(x)=4f(x-2), what is the value of g(0)-f(0)?



88.
      77x^2+(7j+11k)x+jk=0
   In the given equation, j and k are positive constants. The product of the
   solutions to the given equation is ajk, where a is a constant. What is the
   value of a?



89.

==============================================================================
                      PROBLEM-SOLVING AND DATA ANALYSIS                       
==============================================================================

161.
   The median and the mean of the five integers \20, 11, 23, x, x\ are equal.
   What is the sum of all possible values of x?



162.
   55 gallons of a p% chlorine solution are added to 12 gallons of a 15%
   chlorine solution to make a 70% chlorine solution. What is the value of p?
   A) 53
   B) 24
   C) 47
   D) 82



163.
   A farmer has a square field that measures 50 meters on each side. If one
   sack of seed covers 250 square meters, how many sacks of seed does the
   farmer need to plant the entire field?



164.
   A bakery sold cookies in the ratio of chocolate chip to oatmeal as 4:3. If
   the bakery sold 280 chocolate chip cookies, how many oatmeal cookies were
   sold?



165.
   The table shows the exponential relationship between the time, in months,
   since a new colony of bacteria was introduced to a petri dish and the total
   number of bacteria. If the number of bacteria increases by a fixed
   percentage each month, what is the value of b?
   [figure - see the PDF edition]



166.
   A music school offers a series of three workshops. 800 people signed up for
   the first workshop. 45% of the people who signed up for the first workshop
   also signed up for the second workshop, and 20% of the people who signed up
   for both the first and second workshops also signed up for the third
   workshop. How many people signed up for all three workshops?



167.
   Data set A contains 8 values, and data set B contains 24 values. The table
   shows the frequencies of the values for each data set. Which of the
   following statements best compares the means of the two data sets?
   [figure - see the PDF edition]
   A) The mean of data set A is greater than the mean of data set B.
   B) The mean of data set A is less than the mean of data set B.
   C) The mean of data set A is equal to the mean of data set B.
   D) There is not enough information to compare the means of the data sets.



168.
   An orchard has 5 rows of apple trees, 6 rows of pear trees, and 2 rows of
   cherry trees. Each row of apple trees has 7 trees 25 feet or taller and 4
   trees shorter than 25 feet. Each row of pear trees has 9 trees 25 feet or
   taller and 6 trees shorter than 25 feet. Each row of cherry trees has 12
   trees 25 feet or taller and 3 trees shorter than 25 feet. A tree from one
   of these rows will be selected at random. What is the probability of
   selecting a pear tree, given that the tree is 25 feet or taller?
   A) 35/113
   B) 6/13
   C) 54/113
   D) 12/25



169.
   For a magnetic field passing through a flat surface perpendicular to it,
   the magnetic flux through the surface is the product of the magnetic
   field's strength and the area of the surface. A certain flat surface
   consists of two adjacent squares. The side length of the larger square is
   twice the side length of the smaller square. A magnetic field with strength
   20.00 teslas passes uniformly through this surface, perpendicular to the
   magnetic field. If the total magnetic flux through this surface is 2,000
   teslas * meters^2, what is the magnetic flux, in teslas * meters^2, through
   the larger square?



170.
   A certain bamboo plant grows 35 centimeters every p months. At this rate,
   which expression represents the number of centimeters, on average, the
   bamboo plant grows every k years?
   A) 420k/p
   B) 35k/12p
   C) 420p/k
   D) 35p/12k



171.
   Data set A consists of n consecutive integers, where n is an odd integer
   greater than 3. The smallest integer in set A is m. Data set B is created
   by adding the integer (m-5) to set A. Which of the following statements
   must be true?
   I. The range of set B is greater than the range of set A.
   II. The median of set B is less than the median of set A.
   III. The mean of set B is less than the mean of set A.
   A) I and III only
   B) I and II only
   C) II and III only
   D) I, II, and III



172.
   Data set X consists of the weights of 60 animals and has a mean of 30 kg.
   Data set Y consists of the weights of 40 animals and has a mean of 50 kg.
   Data set Z consists of the weights of the 100 animals from data sets X and
   Y.
   What is the mean, in kilograms, of data set Z?



173.
   The positive number a is 480% of the number b, and a is 70% of the number
   c. If c is p% of b, which of the following is closest to the value of p?
   A) 267
   B) 336
   C) 550
   D) 685



174.
   A certain town has an area of 5.48 square miles. Which of the following is
   closest to the area, in square yards, of this town? (1 mile = 1,760 yards)
   A) 552
   B) 964
   C) 9,645
   D) 16,974,848



175.
   A researcher selected 2 random samples of employees in a large company to
   estimate the percentage of employees that planned to vote in favor of a new
   division. Based on the first sample, the researcher estimated that 68% of
   the employees would vote in favor, with an associated margin of error of
   9.7%. Based on the second sample, the researcher estimated that 84% of the
   employees would vote in favor, with an associated margin of error of 6.7%.
   Assuming the margins of error were calculated in the same way, which of the
   following best explains why the second sample obtained a smaller margin of
   error than the first sample?
   A) The first sample contained fewer employees than the second sample.
   B) The first sample contained more employees than the second sample.
   C) The first sample contained a lower percentage of residents that planned
      to vote in favor of a new division.
   D) The first sample contained a higher percentage of residents that planned
      to vote in favor of a new division.



176.
   684 is p% greater than 9. What is the value of p?



177.
   How many liters of a 30% chlorine solution must be added to 12 liters of a
   10% chlorine solution to obtain a 15% chlorine solution?



178.
   Two data sets A and B have 56 values in total. The average of the two data
   sets is 193. Data set A contains 32 values with an average of 208. What is
   the average of data set B?



179.
   Data set A consists of 37 different values that have a minimum of 230, a
   maximum of 278, a mean of 244, and a standard deviation of 9. The values
   230 and 278 are removed from the data set to create data set B. Which of
   the following statements is true?
   A) Both the mean and standard deviation of data set B are less than those
      in data set A.
   B) Both the mean and standard deviation of data set B are greater than
      those in data set A.
   C) The standard deviation of data set B is less than the standard deviation
      in data set A but the mean of both data sets is the same.
   D) The standard deviation of data set B is greater than the standard
      deviation in data set A but the mean of both data sets is the same.

   bottom of each leg that is touching the floor?

197.
   A company conducted a study on the time spent studying per night by
   students in grades 9, 10, and 11 and their average grade point average. A
   total of 5,600 students were selected at random from all students in grades
   9, 10, and 11 in a large school district in the US. The selected students
   were asked to report their number of hours studied as less than 1, from 1--
   3 hours, or more than 3 hours per night. If the results of the study
   suggest a relationship between the self-reported number of hours studied
   and students average grade point average, which of the following aspects of
   the study will prevent these results from being generalized to all students
   in grades 9, 10, and 11 in the US?
   A) The selected students are not all from the same school in the district.
   B) The number of selected students is too small.
   C) The number of selected students from grades 10 and 11 is greater than
      grade 9.
   D) The students were not selected at random from all students in grades 9,
      10, and 11 in the US.



198.
   Substance D is made up of substances A, B, and C. The total mass of
   substance B is 621.6 grams, which makes up 42% of substance D. Of the
   remaining mass of substance D, 60% was substance A, and the remainder was
   substance C. Based on this information, how many grams of substance D is
   substance C?

   C is p% of the speed of object B, what is the value of p?

   For the positive quantities a, b, and c, 78% of c is equivalent to 0.096%
   of b, and b is equivalent to 250% of a. What percentage of c is a?

   The expression 0.0004x represents the result of decreasing a positive

203.
   An architectural model of a square campus has a side length of 405 inches,
   and 1 inch on the model is equal to an actual distance of 270 feet. A
   smaller version of the same campus is constructed with the side length of
   the square 65% shorter than the side length of the previous model. On the
   smaller model, which of the following is closest to the actual distance, in
   feet, represented by 1 inch?
   A) 94.5
   B) 175.5
   C) 415.38
   D) 771.43



204.
   A petri dish had x number of bacteria. A month later the number of bacteria
   increased by 17,456%. What is the resulting number of bacteria on the petri
   dish in terms of x?
   A) 17.456x
   B) 174.56x
   C) 175.56x
   D) 17,456x



205.
   On average, a certain weed grows 63 centimeters every m months. At this
   rate, which expression represents the number of centimeters, on average,
   the weed grows every t years?
   A) 21m/4t
   B) 21t/4m
   C) 756m/t
   D) 756t/m



206.
   The positive number a is 7,848% of the sum of positive numbers b and c, and
   c is 32% of b. What percent of c is a?



207.
   For a study, a group of beavers will be selected from a population of 370
   beavers, and a group of otters will be selected from a population of 420
   otters. Some of the beavers and otters will be in a treatment group, and
   some of the beavers and otters will be in a control group. Which of the
   following is necessary for this study to attempt to establish a cause-and-
   effect relationship between two variables?
   A) The total number of beavers in the study is equal to the total number of
      otters in the study.
   B) The beavers and otters are randomly selected from their habitats.
   C) The proportion of female to male otters in the treatment group is equal
      to the proportion of female to male beavers in the treatment group.
   D) The beavers and otters are randomly assigned to the treatment and
      control groups.



208.
   At the start of a stock trading competition, John's and Julia's stock
   portfolios were of equal value. At the end of the stock trading
   competition, John's portfolio had increased by 330%. Julia's portfolio has
   increased by 2,480%. At the end of the competition Julia's portfolio is
   worth p% more than John's portfolio, what is the value of p?

   rectangular prism B?

   [figure - see the PDF edition]

   what is a possible value of m?
   A) 3sqrt(3)
   B) 5sqrt(2)
   C) 5sqrt(2)-3sqrt(3)
   D) 5sqrt(2)+3sqrt(3)

   x^2+y^2+ax+by+c=0 represents the circle. What is the value of c?



272.
   In triangle ABC, angle C is a right angle, point D lies on AB, point E lies
   on BC, and DE is parallel to AC. If the length of AB is 39 units, DE is 8
   units, the length of AC is greater than the length of BC, and the area of
   triangle ABC is 270 units, what is the length of BE, in units?



273.
   A rectangle is inscribed in a circle such that each vertex of the rectangle
   lies on the circle. The diagonal of the rectangle is twice the length of
   the shortest side of the rectangle. If the area of the circle is 5,929pi
   square units, what is the area, in square units, of the rectangle?
   A) 77sqrt(2)
   B) 77sqrt(3)
   C) 5,929sqrt(2)
   D) 5,929sqrt(3)



274.
   In triangle ABC and triangle DEF, sides BC and EF each have a length of 23
   inches, and angles C and F each measure 43^deg. Which of the following
   additional pieces of information is(are) sufficient to prove that triangle
   ABC is congruent to triangle DEF?
   I. The measures of angles D and E are equal.
   II. The lengths of AB and DE are equal.
   III. The measures of angles A and D are equal.
   A) I only
   B) II only
   C) II and III
   D) III only



275.
   Circle A is defined by the equation (x+14k)^2+(y+27k)^2=81k^2, where k is a
   positive constant. Circle B is the result of shifting circle A up 13k
   units. Which equation defines circle B?
   A) (x+14k)^2+(y+40k)^2=81k^2
   B) (x+14k)^2+(y+14k)^2=81k^2
   C) (x+27k)^2+(y+14k)^2=81k^2
   D) (x+14k)^2+(y+14k)^2=94k^2

   A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (-5,-7). Line a is tangent to
   this circle at (-13,-4). What is the slope of line a?



277.
   Point K lies on a unit circle in the xy-plane and has coordinates (1,0).
   Point O is the center of the circle and has coordinates (0,0). Point J also

   A) I is sufficient, but II is not.
   B) II is sufficient, but I is not.
   C) I is sufficient, and II is sufficient.
   D) Neither I nor II is sufficient.
